{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Identify and remove QA orders (revenue == '999999.99')
qa_mask = df['revenue'] == '999999.99'
df_clean = df[~qa_mask]

# Filter for completed orders only
df_clean_completed = df_clean[df_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute conversion rates by channel and segment
grouped = df_clean_completed.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().reset_index()

# Compute weighted average conversion rate for each channel, weighted by segment size
segment_counts = df_clean_completed.groupby('channel')['customer_segment'].size().reset_index(name='count')

# Merge with conversion rates
segment_rates = grouped.merge(segment_counts, on='channel')

# Compute weighted average conversion rate per channel
segment_rates['weighted_rate'] = segment_rates['converted'] * segment_rates['count']

channel_weighted_rates = segment_rates.groupby('channel')['weighted_rate'].sum() / segment_counts.groupby('channel')['count'].sum()

# Compute difference in weighted conversion rates (email - paid_search)
difference_weighted = channel_weighted_rates['email'] - channel_weighted_rates['paid_search']

print(f'Weighted conversion rate (email): {channel_weighted_rates["email"]}')
print(f'Weighted conversion rate (paid_search): {channel_weighted_rates["paid_search"]}')
print(f'Difference (email - paid_search): {difference_weighted}')"}
